items.reason: Exact Lazurio fork tag, commit and uv.lock digest are profile-neutral release inputs. Live remote provenance was refreshed before publication.
Resident machines receive an integrity-checked non-Git artifact and atomic version switch instead of a credentialless Git bundle checkout.
The scar survives as clean-source, immutable inventory, no-overwrite, corrupted-artifact and active-unchanged regression gates rather than Git checkout reconciliation.

An existing Personalspace tree is adopted by an explicit resolved local mount contract without copy or move. Later lifecycle operations reject retargeting, and a non-empty managed directory is never hidden.
The durable Zulip-to-runtime bridge and its behavioral regression tests moved together with instance names removed from public comments and fixtures.

The unit targets the atomic active Lazurio root and retains the separate bridge UID, configuration refusal and durable queue. The service seam also binds pinned Hermes context discovery to that root through TERMINAL_CWD, preserves both previous systemd inputs, verifies a type-aware predecessor baseline (durable poller state for a resident unit, enabled/active state for an unmanaged legacy unit), performs an atomic cutover, requires Hermes health plus fresh poller registration and restores the old inputs on failure without copying secret values.

The exact fork, commit and lock remain artifact-visible pins. The source-only Ansible role now uses exact uv plus the fork's locked install and upstream gateway service seam; the large legacy bootstrap script is not copied.

The exact fork commit and lock are now artifact-visible. Greenfield Buddy uses GBrain's supported local PGLite plus stdio MCP, avoiding a new PostgreSQL service; an assisted existing host may explicitly retain its already verified engine. Private memory sources and embedding credentials remain Personalspace custody.
Reusable boundary code may move, but the profile repository, constitution, mandates, personality, auth and memory remain private Personalspace inputs and never become artifact payload.

Host provisioning remains source-only. The Linux Buddy lane now proves an authenticated tailnet before mutation, admits the closed private TCP surface only on that interface and refuses to delete foreign Principal rules. The legacy public-ingress classifier is intentionally not copied.

The first cohort reuses its VPS provider snapshot or equivalent recovery mechanism and the playbook requires a content-free restore-verified attestation before mutation. Private keys, bundles and data remain installation custody. A long-lived application backup timer is deliberately deferred until both pilots prove this direction.

The old whole-host orchestrator is not copied. Ansible converges the bounded Linux host baseline and exact runtime dependencies, while the existing compensated rollout alone owns active-root install, service cutover and rollback. Zulip and provider recovery remain explicit external prerequisites.
Stable public behavior is synthesized into Lazurio; internal rationale and anonymized learnings go to Knowledgebase; rollout stays in Mission Control; instance history is not published.
Each component must bring the scars that falsify it. The private corpus is not copied wholesale because some fixtures and histories encode cohort-specific assumptions.
Notices move only with the corresponding migrated dependency or bundled code and must be regenerated against the actual public artifact inventory.
